common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

common.title: Taiwan Blockade
common.line: A quarantine or blockade halts advanced semiconductor exports.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Synthesis screening crisis
notable.line: A major commercial gene-synthesis provider publicly admits fulfilling unscreened orders designed with leaked open-weight assistance, triggering emergency screening mandates outside the EU framework.

notable.title: Siting backlash freeze
notable.line: A coordinated municipal moratorium movement blocks grid connections for new data-centre permitting zones, with court injunctions delaying at least one zone through the turn.
